authorization: User authorized autonomous completion of S014 phase two, within existing data and execution contract
selection_history: After the 20 registered comparisons: recalibration changed coverage but not stable incremental return; within-range volatility/adverse correlations differed by year. This motivates separating two-sided movement scale from directional loss, not retuning the same loss filter.
questions: Can persistent true range forecast future two-sided market amplitude beyond the existing 5-feature baseline?
Does a known close at the actual upper price limit identify next-session nonfill risk for the fixed limit-buy contract?

amplitude.true_range: max(High-Low, abs(High-previous Close), abs(Low-previous Close)) / previous Close using HFQ bars
amplitude.feature: atr20 = arithmetic mean of the most recent 20 completed true ranges through T
amplitude.labels: Average true range over T+1 through T+H for H=1,3,5. This is a market-risk-scale label, NOT executable net return, stop loss, or annual/account drawdown. No fee subtraction from amplitude.
amplitude.augmented: baseline plus atr20; same fixed linear ridge penalty10; no optimization; clipping a negative range forecast at0 is the declared physical output constraint
amplitude.training: Expanding from2020; actual last label date strictly before each test-year first signal. Test2023,2024,2025,2026 through original cutoff minus incomplete horizons.
amplitude.metrics: Paired absolute forecast error reduction in range units, prediction/actual Spearman, training-defined forecast-quartile risk separation and counts by year; report all horizons
amplitude.counterevidence: Inspect rank and error by year; compare predictive scale with directional loss separately; no automatic high-volatility no-trade claim. Two-sided risk can coexist with positive holding returns.

execution.feature: raw Close at the officially supplied same-day UpLimit within half a raw tick (0.005 CNY)
execution.label: Next-session entry_filled from the existing fixed1percent limit SRT/TXE labels, one record per signal irrespective of return-horizon censoring
execution.test: Report eligible count, nonfills and conditional nonfill proportions for limit-close vs other dates, training period and each test year. No-event years remain unavailable for the conditional rate, not zero risk.
execution.limits: Execution planning information only. Nonfill awareness does not establish that skipping a trade improves profit, or permit changing the frozen buy premium.

uncertainty: 5000 paired within-year20-session circular blocks for amplitude loss differences, ordinary95percent and family24 intervals (20 earlier +3 amplitude +1 execution); disclose older32 and adaptive history. Execution proportions are descriptive conditional facts, not success guarantees.
precheck: Mean-range target maturity and prefix equivalence; serial/spawn predictions; pinned native data identity; no network; forecasts train-only
stop: If neither stable entry/loss filtering nor distinct risk-scale/execution use is supported, close with negative/insufficient panel; do not start a new information source or strategy stage. If scale/execution use is supported, deliver only that bounded role with counterevidence and no strategy acceptance claim.
